notes: Correctness fix, not a performance change (kb-20260926-ffe24b0f). CustomTorchBackend.prefill_batch (CPU/MPS) passed an explicit attn_mask and GemmaAttention's attn_mask branch kept the rightmost W key columns for every query row, so a multi-token prefill past the sliding window dropped in-window keys for early queries; and left-padded suffixes left a gap between a shorter row's prefix and suffix keys. Fix: right-pad suffixes (prefix+suffix contiguous per row) and keep keys within W columns of each query (query i at column S_k - S_q + i), identical to the old rule at S_q=1. The assertion is the measurement: tiny random model (window 16), 50-token prompt, teacher-forced continuation logits vs a full forward: max error 1.81 at ec13cfe, 5.7e-6 at bfbb4c3 (monolithic prefill 5.7e-6). Verified failing at base by stashing src/ with the tests in place. Companion tests in the same file: the ragged K>1 wave with prefix hits fails at base (1.17) and also with only the attention fix applied (0.52, the padding defect); the S_q=1 decode-mask test is byte-identical (torch.equal) against the old rule. CUDA (paged prefill kernel) untouched.
